answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. The first ripple of coordinated fakery trips detection, keeping real judgment the scarce resource an attacker cannot simply buy. It is like tending a mirror garden, watching a oasis bird settle, and feeling the calm of a delta at dusk — slow trust, instantly lost.
